name: 社交媒体互动率计算器

map.计算社交媒体内容互动率，衡量内容吸引力和用户参与度: Compute engagement rate for social content to measure how appealing it is and how much users participate
map.📖 查看「社交媒体互动率计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Social Media Engagement Rate Calculator User Guide"
map.互动率 =（点赞 + 评论 + 分享）÷ 粉丝数 × 100%；互动曝光率 =（: Engagement rate = (likes + comments + shares) / followers × 100%; engagement-to-impression rate = (likes + comments + shares) / impressions × 100%, which measures the interaction quality of the content.
map.评估一条内容（赞+评+藏+转）的互动表现。: Assess how one piece of content performs on likes, comments, saves and shares.
map.对比不同账号/时段互动率找最优发布节奏。: Compare engagement rates across accounts and time slots to find the best posting rhythm.
map.网红投放前用互动率而非粉丝数判性价比。: Judge influencer value by engagement rate rather than follower count before booking.
map.一条笔记获赞 300、评论 120、收藏 60、转发 20，总互动 500；粉丝: One post gets 300 likes, 120 comments, 60 saves and 20 shares, so 500 interactions in total; with 10000 followers, engagement rate = 500/10000 = 5%, an excellent level.
map.同样 500 互动、曝光 50000 → 互动率=1%，用于衡量内容对泛流量的吸: The same 500 interactions against 50000 impressions gives an engagement rate of 1%, which measures how well the content attracts broad traffic.
map.互动率分母用粉丝还是曝光？: Should the denominator be followers or impressions?
map.粉丝基数看铁粉粘性，曝光基数看内容破圈力，两个都看更全面。: The follower base shows how loyal core fans are and the impression base shows whether content breaks out; looking at both gives the full picture.
map.互动≠购买，种草内容互动高但挂车转化低，需看进店/成交漏斗下一环。: Engagement is not purchase: product-seeding content can engage well but convert poorly on the shopping link, so look at the next step of the store visit and purchase funnel.
